Tests that if an iframe is loaded and then deleted, inspector can still return its response body, including when iframe.src is changed to a javascript: URL after loading.
Case 1 URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/hello-world.html
resource.type: Document
response.status: 200
base64Encoded: false
resource.content after requesting content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<body>
  <h1>hello world</h1>
</body>

Case 2 URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/hello-world.html
resource.type: Document
response.status: 200
base64Encoded: false
resource.content after requesting content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<body>
  <h1>hello world</h1>
</body>
